_instructions: Benchmark: end-to-end simulation of complete dialogs.
The system runs the full dialog with a simulated (scripted) user.
task_description    : task text for the DialogManager
frame_schema_json   : frame schema as a JSON string (for slot_filling)
If '', the LLM generates it (slower, less reproducible)
resources_json      : resources for the context (JSON string array, '' = empty)
user_script         : ordered list of simulated user responses
If exhausted before the dialog ends, it simulates a timeout
expected_success    : true if the dialog should end in success
expected_final_frame: expected frame values at the end (for slot_filling)
Compared against the actual frame on completion
notes               : description of the pattern being tested
For quiz: resources_json must contain the array of questions.
For slot_filling: frame_schema_json defines the slots.

cases.description: Happy path — pedido de helado, 3 turnos, sin correcciones
